extraction_scope: Worker-2 re-review converted XML Table 1 CTC50 values and XML Table 2 MIC/zone cells into row-level activity/toxicity records, with PDF text and supplementary text checked for additional activity tables.

assay_conditions.incubation: bacterial cultures 37 C for 18 h; fungal cultures 37 C for 48 h
assay_conditions.reference_drug_context: gatifloxacin for bacteria; griseofulvin for fungi
assay_conditions.source_column_context: Table 2 row for compound 7, Bacillus subtilis; cell reports zone diameter with MIC in brackets.
